The decision leans on YC/company-site evidence and treats HN as a weak freshness signal. Metadata: YC batch: Summer 2025; Industry: Education; Status: Active; Stage: Early; Team size: 8
risks: Founder backgrounds and customer traction are not deeply verified from the available public evidence.
HN traction may be absent or noisy for B2B companies.
The product could be a thin AI interface unless workflow depth is confirmed.
If the company is acquired or inactive, it is outside the seed-stage sourcing target.
